name: RogueIQ
tagline: Money tools that show their work.
subline: Simple personal finance and investing tools, plus plain-language explainers built on primary-source public data, so you can check the numbers and make your own calls. Built in public by a small team with AI agents.
description: RogueIQ makes simple personal finance and investing tools and plain-language guides built on primary-source public data, so you can check the numbers yourself. Calculators and organizers for education.
disclaimer: RogueIQ offers education, calculators and organizers. Nothing here is personalized financial advice. Check the sources and make your own decisions.
